init.title: Gemini assistant options
init.description: Configure the conversation model, Home Assistant control and voice.

data_description.chat_model: Text model used by the conversation agent for chat and for the Assist voice pipeline (STT -> model -> TTS). Each request is independent.
data_description.prompt: System instructions for the assistant. The default asks it to fetch only the device/area it needs via GetLiveContext.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Expose Home Assistant tools (Assist) so Gemini can control devices and read states.
data_description.temperature: Creativity of the text model (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative).
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens in the model answer.
data_description.enable_live: EXPERIMENTAL: enables the realtime Gemini Live module. It is NOT used by the standard Assist dialog; it needs a custom audio client that keeps a WebSocket session open, like a phone call.
data_description.live_model: Realtime audio model used only by the Live module (not by the text conversation agent).
data_description.live_voice: Voice used by the Live module.
data_description.stt_model: Speech-to-text model used by the Assist pipeline to turn your voice into text.
data_description.tts_model: Text-to-speech model used by the Assist pipeline to speak the answer.
data_description.tts_voice: Voice used for text-to-speech (e.g. Puck, Kore, Charon).
